No first step

Every class costs money before they’ve met you

From Guilt to Grounded is a replay people pay for. Someone who loved one reel has no free way to spend an hour with you, so most of them just keep scrolling.

Low ticket

Your products have no front door

The boundary course and the replay sit on your resources page behind buttons. I found nothing that sends a follower to them at the moment they care most.

No qualifier

“Get the deets” can’t tell you who’s ready

Culture + Connection has no application in front of it. You can’t see who is ready to invest now, so every enquiry gets the same attention, ready or not.

70.1k people already trust your voice. There’s no free, repeatable moment yet where they meet you live and choose their next step.

My recommendation

A free live masterclass, your boundary course on the thank-you page, and an application on the replay

You already have low-ticket products, so the masterclass itself should be free. It’s education and coaching, not therapy: one hour on guilt, boundaries and staying close to family, drawing on what you already teach. The boundary course earns from day one and pays for the ads, and the replay page invites the ready women to apply for Culture + Connection or Roots + Fruits.

Gives them a free first hour

A free class is the easiest yes for someone who isn’t ready for a program. They hear how you think, and every sign-up becomes an email you own.

Puts your course in front of buyers

Everyone who registers sees the boundary course on the thank-you page, while they’re most curious. That revenue covers the ad spend.

Shows you who’s ready

The women who stay to the end and apply have told you their goals and their timing before the call, so you only talk to the ones who fit.

The 95%*

Curious, not ready for a program yet

They join the free class and many add the boundary course to keep going at their own pace. CULTURED and your emails keep them close until they’re ready.

The qualified 5%

Ready to invest in change now

They stay for the whole hour and apply from the replay page. A short application (where they are, what they want to change, 1:1 or group, timing) means every call is with someone who fits.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Bridge, don’t break: boundaries with family, without the guilt spiral

A free 60-minute masterclass with psychologist and coach Dr. Pauline Yeghnazar Peck, made for daughters of immigrant families. How to say what you need, handle the guilt that follows, and stay close to the people you love.

Who it’s for

Made for daughters who are the bridge in their family

  • Women who love their parents and want a closer, more honest relationship with them.
  • Women who want to say no, or not yet, without a week of guilt afterwards.
  • Women navigating two cultures at once, at home, at work and in their own relationships.
  • Anyone who wants practical words to use in the next hard family conversation.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in one hour

Where the guilt comes from

Why setting a limit can feel like betrayal in many immigrant families, and what that feeling is really telling you.

Boundaries that protect the relationship

The difference between a wall and a bridge, and why a clear boundary can bring you closer instead of pushing family away.

Translating what you need

Pauline’s “translation” approach to saying your needs in a way your parents can actually hear.

Words for the hard moments

Simple scripts for the conversations that come up again and again: visits, choices, partners, money and time.

What to do after you’ve said it

How to stay steady when the pushback comes, so one conversation doesn’t undo the change you’re making.

Meet your host

Hi, I’m Pauline

I’m a first-generation Iranian-Armenian psychologist, speaker and coach. I founded Noor Therapy + Wellness, and my work has always centred on children of immigrants and intercultural families.

Today I focus on education, speaking and coaching, and I host CULTURED, a free monthly book club for the children of immigrants. This masterclass is me sharing what I teach, for free, with anyone who wants to learn.

Questions

Good to know

What’s the difference between 1:1 and the group?

Culture + Connection is a one-to-one deep dive into your personal and family story. Roots + Fruits is the group version: four 1-hour Zoom sessions with 8 to 10 women, exercises and a WhatsApp community.

Is this therapy?

No. Both programs are psychologically informed education and coaching, not therapy.

What happens after I apply?

I read every application. If it looks like a fit, you’ll pick a time for a call where we decide together which option suits you.

Script 1 · “A wall or a bridge”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“A boundary with your parents can be a wall, or it can be a bridge.”

Body

“As a psychologist, I see so many daughters of immigrant families stuck between keeping the peace and keeping themselves. The good news is that boundaries are a skill, and they can bring a family closer, not push it apart.”

CTA

“I teach exactly how in my free live masterclass, Bridge, Don’t Break. Tap Sign up to save your seat. Replay included.”

Shot: Pauline to camera, mustard blazer, mandala-blue backdrop, captions on. End card: “Educational content, not medical advice.”

Script 2 · “The guilt after the no”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Why does saying no to family come with so much guilt?”

Body

“In many immigrant families, love and duty are woven together. So a limit can feel like betrayal, even when it isn’t. In one free hour I’ll explain where that feeling comes from, and what to say instead.”

CTA

“Join my free masterclass on Zoom. Cameras can stay off. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: walking-and-talking, then a close-up for the CTA. On-screen text in Fraunces.

Script 3 · “Three things in one hour”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Three things I’ll teach in one free hour.”

Body

“One: where the guilt comes from. Two: how to translate what you need so your parents can hear it. Three: words for the conversations that keep coming up, and what to do when they push back.”

CTA

“Bridge, Don’t Break, my free live masterclass. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: text cards in blue and mustard with the mandala pattern, voice-over from Pauline.
